description.zh: 你和 Agent 一起管的记事本：在手机上看，让 Agent 记、改、整理。
description.en: A notebook you keep with your Agent: read it here, the Agent writes, edits and tidies it.

prompt.zh: 在记事本 {{data.path}} 最上面记一条（带今天的日期）：
prompt.en: Add a note at the top of my notebook {{data.path}} (with today's date):

prompt.zh: 帮我整理记事本 {{data.path}}：合并重复的、按主题加小标题、过期的移到最后「已归档」一节。只改这一个文件，改完用一两句话告诉我改了什么。
prompt.en: Tidy up my notebook {{data.path}}: merge duplicates, add headings by topic, move stale notes to an "Archived" section at the end. Change only this file and tell me in a sentence or two what changed.
